newsitem.title: UK: UK's Major--minimum wage may cost one mln jobs.
newsitem.headline: UK's Major--minimum wage may cost one mln jobs.

text.p: A minimum wage of four pounds an hour could cost Britain up to a million jobs, Prime Minister John Major said on Tuesday.
He said skilled workers would demand increases to preserve their wage differentials over and above the level of any minimum wage determined by the Labour Party.

"If the minimum wage were about four pounds an hour, upon that basis with the sort of differentials one might expect, you might well lose up to a milion jobs," Major told a call-in programme on Sky television
Labour, favourites to win the May 1 election, have pledged to introduce a minimum wage but have not yet decided on its level, saying this will be agreed in talks with employers and unions.
